message.content:
This editorial illustration is a magazine cover with a cream-colored, textured background. A central, sepia-toned portrait features a young man seated and facing forward. He wears a patterned batik headcloth (blangkon) and a dark, floral-patterned tunic with long sleeves. Two long beaded necklaces hang around his neck and over his chest. His hands are folded in his lap, and he wears a dark, patterned sarong.

In the upper-left corner, a red circular seal contains the white number "70th" and the words "INDONESIA MERDEKA" and "AYO KERJA." The word "TEMPO" is printed in large, black, serif capital letters across the upper center. Above it is the text "EDISI KHUSUS HARI KEMERDEKAAN," and below it is "17-23 AGUSTUS 2015." To the right, a black-and-white circular icon shows a row of four rectangular shapes. Below this, bold black text reads "HAMENGKU BUWONO IX," followed by the thinner text "PENGORBANAN SANG PEMBELA REPUBLIK." The bottom left features a barcode, the price "RP 45.000," and publication details including "WWW.TEMPO.CO" and "ISSN: 0126 - 4273."
